topSignals.title: FERC RM26-4 Deadline Day: All Six RTOs/ISOs Must File Large-Load Tariff Reforms
topSignals.text: — August 17 is the hard statutory deadline under FERC's June 18 Section 206 show cause orders. PJM, MISO, NYISO, SPP, CAISO, and ISO-NE must submit revised large-load interconnection tariff language or compliance responses justifying the status quo. No filings were confirmed as of August 16. Today's submissions will define — in formal tariff text — how co-located large loads (>20 MW, ≥69 kV) interact with the transmission grid across ~70% of US electrical load, converting the estimated $5–20/MWh avoided-transmission-cost SOFC LCOE benefit into a quantifiable, jurisdiction-specific tariff input. LCOE model update due August 18 once filings are reviewed. PJM's February 2026 co-location filing had already proposed a "Bring Your Own Generation" (BYOG) expedited track and new service carve-outs for co-located data centers — today's RM26-4 response may expand or revise that framework. FERC RM26-4 docket | McGuireWoods | White & Case on PJM BYOG | BD Law

topSignals.title: Oracle Project Jupiter: NMED Hearing Examiner Withdraws Aug 11 Gas-Supply Deadline — All Issues Deferred to September 14
topSignals.text: — Hearing examiner Max Shepherd withdrew his August 5 order (which had required Yucca Growth Infrastructure to respond to New Energy Economy's dismissal motion by August 11), ruling that all gas supply questions — including the unresolved half-mile state trust land pipeline crossing — will be addressed at the September 14 public hearing. The withdrawal preserves the September 14 date but confirms the fuel supply path for the 2.45 GW Bloom SOFC campus remains legally unresolved through at least November 2026 (when an air permit decision is expected). Oracle maintains the project is on schedule. ABQ Journal | NM Env Law Center | NMED Aug 4 order

topSignals.title: PUCT August 20 Hearing — 3 Days Out: Audit Scope and Self-Supply Carve-Out Decision for 474 GW Texas Queue
topSignals.text: — The PUCT August 20 open meeting will establish the scope, timeline, and interim interconnection rules for the suspended ERCOT Batch Zero Large Load process covering ~250–300 projects (474 GW, 90% data centers). The pivotal question is whether self-supply SOFC projects (behind-the-meter, not requiring ERCOT interconnection) receive explicit carve-out language exempting them from the audit. Hedgehog USA Texas (1.5 GW Bloom SOFC, 104 MW Phase 1 pre-construction) is among the projects in limbo. Market consensus treats the Texas grid pause as structurally bullish for on-site fuel cell bypass. Gibson Dunn | Greenberg Traurig | Texas Tribune

items.text: Elcogen (priority): Quiet day August 17. Status unchanged: E3000 G2 platform (>75% FC electrical efficiency, 90% with heat recovery, 650°C operating temperature) in volume production at ELCO I Tallinn (360 MW/yr); deliveries to key partners ongoing since Q2 2026. Most recent external activity: August 3 insights piece by Stefano Piscitelli on industrial energy strategy. No new product or partnership announcements. Elcogen

Topsoe (priority): Quiet day August 17. Status unchanged: Herning SOEC factory (500 MW/yr) hibernated pending H2 demand recovery; CEO Elena Scaltritti since June 1, 2026; FY2026 guidance DKK 7,600–8,400M; SOFC/data-center commercial pathway deferred to 2029+. No new SOFC announcements. Topsoe
Other players: Quiet day. No new announcements from Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, or Aisin beyond items in prior digests.

Oracle Project Jupiter (2.45 GW Bloom SOFC, Dona Ana County NM): See Top Signal #2. NMED hearing examiner withdrawal of Aug 11 order confirms all gas supply and pipeline access disputes proceed to September 14 hearing. No construction can begin without resolved fuel supply and a granted air permit; earliest decision timeline November 2026.

13 US States reconsidering data center tax breaks (August 2026): Thirteen states moved to roll back or revisit data center tax incentives in August 2026, reflecting a shift from pure-incentive to cost-allocation and demand-response frameworks. This reduces the economic advantage of grid-connected data center projects and implicitly strengthens the self-supply bypass value proposition. Data Center Knowledge

Active pipeline carry-forward unchanged: Nebius/Bloom 328 MW Vineland NJ (confirmed active Aug 12); Crusoe/Cheyenne 900 MW Phase 1 (first data halls H2 2026); Hedgehog Texas 1.5 GW (104 MW Phase 1, ERCOT audit status pending August 20 PUCT); FCEL/Fit Energy 380 MW (30 MW initial delivery H2 2026); Equinix >100 MW (19+ DCs); Bloom/Brookfield $25B EaaS framework; ECL/PowerCell 300 MW+ H2-ready.

FERC RM26-4 — Deadline day, August 17: See Top Signal #1. Monitor FERC eLibrary from today for filings from PJM, MISO, NYISO, SPP, CAISO, and ISO-NE. Key extraction targets: (a) explicit self-supply or co-located load exemption mechanisms; (b) cost-allocation structures for large loads that do interconnect; (c) queue study timelines and reform specifics. LCOE model update August 18. FERC eLibrary RM26-4

ERCOT/PUCT August 20 hearing (3 days): See Top Signal #3. Outcome determines audit scope and any interim self-supply carve-out language. Monitor for ERCOT's "good cause" exception motion filing and PUCT staff recommendations ahead of meeting.

Background unchanged: NY EO 62 data center moratorium (50 MW+, islanded exemption active); Germany EnEfG PUE ≤1.2/ERF ≥10%/15% waste heat from July 2026; EU CADA energy efficiency rating scheme delayed; ITC 48E 30% credit active for all fuel cell feedstocks.

Rolls-Royce SMR GDA Step 3 — Still no DAC as August runs out: The 53-month UK Generic Design Assessment was projected to complete in August 2026. As of August 16, no Design Acceptance Confirmation (DAC) has been published by ONR. With two weeks remaining in August, either the DAC arrives this month (marking the first Western SMR to clear full UK regulatory assessment and triggering Wylfa construction authorization) or the process slips to Q4 2026. A slip further widens SOFC's deployment speed advantage in UK/European near-term markets. ONR GDA | World Nuclear News

Background unchanged: 13 hyperscaler nuclear deals totalling >9.8 GW; nuclear 10+ year lead times remain SOFC's primary competitive differentiator for near-term deployment; battery LCOE ~$25/MWh unsuitable for 24/7 AI baseload.

Bloom Energy (BE): Stock rebounding from the August 14 close (~$246) following the Project Jupiter pipeline sell-off. One analyst summary from the August 17 week shows approximately $345.85 (+250% YTD), suggesting a sharp recovery in the direction of the August 12 record close (~$391). Securities class action lawsuits (covering Q1 2026 guidance statements) have a September 28, 2026 deadline. Pending near-term catalysts: FERC RM26-4 filings (today), PUCT August 20 hearing, NMED September 14 hearing, Bloom 10-Q (due September 11), Q3 earnings (October). StockAnalysis | Yahoo Finance | 247wallst
FuelCell Energy (FCEL): No material new disclosures. Torrington factory targeting 100 MW/yr annualized run rate by October 31, 2026. Q3 FY2026 earnings expected ~September 2026.

Ceres Power (CWR.L): No new corporate announcements. Next catalyst: H1 2026 results (September). Doosan/Reverion $76.7M deal (covered August 16) continues to support Goldman Sachs Conviction Buy (168% upside) thesis.

ACS Energy & Fuels: Mobile SOFC with NaBH4 Hydrogen Generation (March 7, 2026, first appearance in digest) — "Design and the Study of the Mobile Solid Oxide Fuel Cell System with Hydrogen Generation" presents a self-sustaining mobile SOFC that generates hydrogen via NaBH4 hydrolysis using recovered anode off-gas condensate water. Application is portable, but the closed-loop hydrogen self-sufficiency concept (recovering water -> generating H2 -> feeding SOFC) is relevant for data center SOFC systems exploring fuel supply independence from the natural gas grid. ACS Energy & Fuels

"Optimization of SOFC Combined Steam and Power System Utilizing By-Product Hydrogen" (ScienceDirect, 2025, pii S0360319925044842, first appearance) — Develops a 25 kW SOFC Combined Steam and Power (CSP) system fueled by industrial by-product hydrogen; optimizes to maximize combined steam and power output, achieving reported combined energy utilization ~88–92%. Context: by-product H2 feedstock (petrochemical), not directly data-center applicable, but supports CHP architecture trade studies where process steam is a deliverable alongside power. Not LCOE-model relevant as a standalone reference. ScienceDirect

lcoe.text: FERC RM26-4 filings (today, August 17): Extract formal avoided-transmission-cost range and co-located/self-supply cost-allocation treatment from each RTO filing. Priority: PJM BYOG track cost parameters, MISO large-load study timeline, NYISO self-supply treatment. This replaces the $5–20/MWh estimate with a tariff-backed input. Model update August 18.

Project Jupiter fuel supply risk (through at least November 2026): Gas supply unresolved through the September 14 hearing; air permit decision not before November. Sensitivity-test Bloom backlog conversion schedule with a 6–12 month Jupiter delay. No change to per-kWh SOFC LCOE structure.
PUCT August 20 self-supply carve-out (3 days): Explicit carve-out preserves Texas SOFC pipeline on schedule; absence of carve-out adds 1–2 quarter delay to Texas deployment scenarios.

Background carry-forward unchanged: US natural gas $4.00–4.90/MMBtu (EIA 2026); SOFC commercial system capex $4,000–6,000/kW (target $1,000/kW); ITC 48E reduces effective capex to $2,800–4,200/kW; CCGT $2,000–2,200/kW; solar+battery $25/MWh LCOE (24/7 baseload-unsuitable).

Pending (carry-forward, priority-ranked): (1) FERC RM26-4 RTO/ISO filings today -> LCOE model update August 18. (2) PUCT August 20 ERCOT Batch Zero hearing - self-supply carve-out. (3) NMED September 14 air permit hearing for Project Jupiter. (4) Bloom 10-Q shipped MW extraction (SEC EDGAR, due September 11). (5) Elcogen E3000 G2 system-level efficiency confirmation at ELCO I production scale. (6) Ceres H1 2026 results (September). (7) Bloom Q3 2026 earnings (October). (8) Rolls-Royce SMR GDA Step 3 DAC from ONR (scheduled August 2026, pending as of August 16).
